The bug is in [truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L177-L187) inside `clinicbench.truth.build`. For `change_of_mind` patients, when the initial `schedule["works"]` has only one slot, `t["schedule"]["works"][1:]` is empty and `new_works` falls back to `rng.sample(cand, 1)`. However, `cand` only excludes `dropped` and does not filter out slots excluded by `t["schedule"]["hard_limits"]` (or `t["doctor"]["refuses"]`), so the post-event `schedule["works"]` can contain a slot that violates the patient's own hard limit.

Because [truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py) is frozen instrument code listed in [phase3-freeze.json](file:///work/docs/phase3-freeze.json#L8), this is a `fix`.

Fixed the `change_of_mind` replacement slot sampling in [truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L177-L183).

### Change
- In `clinicbench.truth.build`, collected `excl = {s for lim in t["schedule"]["hard_limits"] for s in lim["excludes"]}` and filtered `s not in excl` when building `cand` for `change_of_mind` patients.
